briefdescription.para: Writes to the serial EEPROM connected to the SPI interface.

detaileddescription.para: The function is not designed to be a driver to handle all the conditions of the EEPROM device. The EEPROM contains a 32 byte write buffer which can be filled and then a write is automatically performed by the device. All the data put into the buffer must be in the same page of the device with page boundaries being on 32 byte boundaries.

The number of bytes to write.

briefdescription.para: Illustrates how to use the XSpiPs device driver in polled mode.

detaileddescription.para: This test writes and reads data from a serial EEPROM. The serial EEPROM part must be present in the hardware to use this example.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the device.

simplesect.para:
- The function calls functions which contain loops that may be infinite if interrupts are not working such that it may not return. If the device slave select is not correct and the device is not responding on bus it reads a status of 0xFF for the status register as the bus is pulled up.
In XSCT/classic flow, the device configuration is looked up based on DeviceId.

briefdescription.para: Calls the SPI EEPROM polled example.
Implements a design example using the SPI driver (XSpiPs) in polled mode with a serial EEPROM device.

detaileddescription.para: The hardware which this example runs on must have a serial EEPROM (Microchip 25XX320 or 25XX160) for it to run. The example has been tested with the SPI EEPROM on the EP4.5 ARM processor.
